author: Zephyr I
title: LN-gated ConvLSTM + 1-head Attn: micro-sweep (entropy, vcoef, lr)
abstract: Micro-sweep around SOTA: entropy_coef ∈ {0.008, 0.01, 0.012}, value_loss_coef ∈ {0.45, 0.5, 0.55}, lr ∈ {3e-4, 4e-4}. Architecture fixed (LN-gated ConvLSTM 64ch + 1-head attention).

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/zephyr')
from networks.cnn_convlstm_layernorm import CNNConvLSTMLN_Attn
from ray import tune

BASE_SEED = 42

def _define_hyperparameters():
    return {
        'learning_rate': tune.choice([3e-4, 4e-4]),
        'entropy_coef': tune.choice([0.008, 0.01, 0.012]),
        'value_loss_coef': tune.choice([0.45, 0.5, 0.55]),
        'cnn_features_1': tune.choice([32]),
        'cnn_features_2': tune.choice([64]),
        'conv_lstm_features': tune.choice([64]),
    }

def create_network(hparams):
    return CNNConvLSTMLN_Attn(
        cnn_features_1=hparams['cnn_features_1'],
        cnn_features_2=hparams['cnn_features_2'],
        conv_lstm_features=hparams['conv_lstm_features'],
        attn_temp=1.0,
    )
